mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM pf.task t JOIN pf.attempt a ON a.space_id=t.space_id AND a.task_id=t.id JOIN pf.conversation_lease l ON l.space_id=t.space_id AND l.conversation_id=t.conversation_id JOIN pf.execution_dispatch d ON d.task_id=t.id JOIN pf.execution_slot e ON e.task_id=t.id JOIN pf.task_resource_binding rb ON rb.space_id=t.space_id AND rb.task_id=t.id AND rb.actor_id=t.creator_id WHERE t.id=#{command.taskId} AND t.space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND t.creator_id=#{command.actorId} AND t.status='RUNNING' AND rb.workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND a.id=#{command.attemptId} AND a.owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND a.fencing_token=#{command.fence} AND a.dispatch_generation=#{command.generation} AND a.status='RUNNING' AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND l.task_id=t.id AND l.attempt_id=a.id AND l.owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND l.generation=#{command.generation} AND l.fencing_token=#{command.fence} AND l.lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND d.lease_owner=#{command.ownerId} AND d.generation=#{command.generation} AND d.fencing_token=#{command.fence} AND d.lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND e.owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND e.fencing_token=#{command.fence} AND e.lease_until>clock_timestamp() )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.capability_materialization_command(operation_id,command_id,space_id,task_id,attempt_id,actor_id,owner_id,workspace_id, generation,fence,manifest_hash,request_hash,command_json,state,revision) VALUES(#{command.operationId},#{command.commandId},#{command.spaceId},#{command.taskId},#{command.attemptId},#{command.actorId},#{command.ownerId},#{command.workspaceId}, #{command.generation},#{command.fence},#{command.manifestHash},#{hash},CAST(#{json} AS jsonb),'RUNNING',1) ON CONFLICT(operation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,command_json::text AS command_json,request_hash,state,receipt_json::text AS receipt_json,receipt_hash,error_code,revision FROM pf.capability_materialization_command WHERE operation_id=#{operation}
